text: dsh-spark-monitor 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 与 Desktop 客户端的插件，在输入框状态栏展示 DGX Spark 节点监控和 GPU 时钟控制。Host 端按配置通过 SSH 采集最多 4 台主机的温度、内存、swap、运行时间与负载，前端以状态 pill 聚合最高温度和内存占用，并可悬停查看各节点详情。点击时钟按钮可为所有节点应用配置的 MHz 档位或 unlimited。适合需要从 DSH 查看 Spark 节点状态并调整 GPU 时钟的用户。需要配置 SSH alias；时钟功能要求远端可免密 sudo 执行 nvidia-smi。

dsh-spark-monitor adds Spark monitoring and GPU clock controls to DSH. It samples temperature, memory, and swap over SSH from up to four nodes, with per-node details on hover. Choose a clock tier to apply across nodes. Clock control needs SSH aliases and passwordless sudo.
想在 DSH 状态栏查看几台 DGX Spark 的温度和内存。
能不能从 DSH 里看远程 Spark 节点的负载和 swap？
让 DSH 帮我一键切换多台机器的 GPU 时钟档位。
dsh-spark-monitor 的功能「节点状态监控」：Host 端定时通过 SSH 读取各节点的温度、内存、swap、运行时间和负载，并在状态栏显示聚合温度与内存占用；悬停可查看每台节点的数值和采样时间。
dsh-spark-monitor 的功能「GPU 时钟档位控制」：点击状态栏的时钟按钮打开档位弹层，选择配置的 MHz 档位或 unlimited 后，插件通过 SSH 将设置应用到所有已配置节点，并显示结果。
@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 15 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · Features：- **Aggregate status pills** — one pill shows the hottest node, one shows the fullest memory; hovering either lists every node with its own value and sample age.
- **Configurable nodes** — 1 to 4 nodes, each with its own SSH alias, display label, and per-node temperature / memory switches.
- **Configurable clock tiers** — any list of MHz values plus `unlimited`, applied to all nodes from a single click; the popover highlights the current tier.
- **Per-node failure isolation** — one unreachable node does not break the others; its pill line shows the error.
- **en / zh** dictionaries and a native settings form in the Desktop plugin manager.

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (Web UI / Desktop profile).
- Node.js `>= 20` (only for local development).
- SSH aliases for every node in `~/.ssh/config`, reachable without a password prompt (`BatchMode=yes`).
- Passwordless sudo on every node for `nvidia-smi` (`sudo -n nvidia-smi ...` must work).
- `nvidia-smi` installed on the nodes (only needed for the clock feature).

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · Passwordless sudo (clock feature only)：Sampling temperature and memory needs no privileges. Applying a clock tier runs `sudo -n nvidia-smi -lgc ...`, so the SSH user needs a NOPASSWD rule:

```sudoers

**Desktop:** open the Plugins page, choose **Add plugin**, and enter `github:zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor` (or the absolute path of a local checkout), then reload the page. The Desktop profile is owned by the Electron app, so `dsh plugin --profile desktop` is not the way to install there.

text:
@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · Configuration：The plugin assumes **no host names of its own**: with no `hosts` configured it samples nothing and draws nothing in the status bar. Add your nodes in your profile's patch layer (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`) or in the Desktop plugin-manager form. Replace `node-1` / `node-2` below with the SSH aliases from your own `~/.ssh/config`:

```yaml
- id: spark-monitor
  name: "@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor"
  config:
    hosts:

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hosts[].alias` | — (required) | SSH alias from `~/.ssh/config`. Allowed characters: `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`. With no hosts, nothing is sampled. |
| `hosts[].label` | alias | Display label used in tooltips. |
| `hosts[].temperature` | `true` | Sample temperatures for this node. |
| `hosts[].memory` | `true` | Sample memory and swap for this node. |
| `tiers[]` | `1710, 1950, 2190, unlimited` | Clock tiers offered by the popover. Numbers are MHz; `unlimited` runs `nvidia-smi -rgc`. |
| `clock` | `true` | Enable the GPU clock tier control. Set `false` to hide the clock button when `nvidia-smi` needs a password. |
| `intervalSeconds` | `300` | Host sampling interval (30–86400). |
| `timeoutSeconds` | `20` | Whole SSH command deadline (5–120). |
@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · Configuration：The Desktop plugin manager renders the same fields as a form.

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · How it works：- **Sampling.** The Host half runs one SSH command per node per interval. It reads `hwmon` `temp*_input` files (millidegrees), `/proc/meminfo` (`MemTotal`, `MemAvailable`, `SwapTotal`, `SwapFree`), uptime and load. Each node's snapshot is stored independently; `ageSeconds` is computed by the Host per request.
- **Clock tiers.** Applying a tier runs `sudo -n sh -c 'nvidia-smi -lgc 0,<MHz> && …'` (or `-rgc` for `unlimited`) and records the tier in `/var/lib/gpu-clock-lock/tier` on the node. The record file exists because the driver exposes **no query** for the locked clock — only set/reset; the optional boot service below writes the same file so the pill can show the boot tier after a reboot.

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · Optional: persist the clock limit across reboots：`nvidia-smi -lgc` is a runtime setting, so a reboot clears it. The plugin never installs or edits any service — this is only a companion example for people who want the limit to survive a reboot.

```ini
section: Optional: persist the clock limit across reboots

text:
@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · /etc/systemd/system/gpu-clock-lock.service：[Unit]
Description=Lock GPU clocks for thermal control

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/nvidia-smi -lgc 0,2190
ExecStartPost=/bin/sh -c 'mkdir -p /var/lib/gpu-clock-lock && echo 2190 > /var/lib/gpu-clock-lock/tier && chmod 644 /var/lib/gpu-clock-lock/tier'
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · /etc/systemd/system/gpu-clock-lock.service：Replace both `2190` values with your tier. `ExecStartPost` only writes the tier record so the status pill can show the boot tier (the driver has no query for the locked clock). Without this service the plugin still works: the tier applies at runtime, and after a reboot the clocks revert and the pill shows `—` until you pick a tier again.

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · Limitations：- There is no way to read the *actual* locked clock back from the driver; the plugin shows the last tier it applied (or the boot service's tier). A manual `nvidia-smi -lgc` outside the plugin is invisible.
- `nvidia-smi -lgc` does not survive a reboot; use the optional boot service above to persist it.
- The clock feature needs passwordless sudo; without it the apply fails and the error is shown per node.
- SSH aliases must resolve without interactive prompts; use `BatchMode=yes`-friendly keys.

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
node --test
```

The Host tests use a fake SSH runner (`setRemoteRunner`) and exercise the registered Fetch routes directly.

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · 功能：- **聚合状态 pill** —— 一个显示最热的节点，一个显示内存占用最高的节点；悬停可列出每台节点的数值与采样时间。
- **可配置节点** —— 1 到 4 台，每台可单独设置 SSH 别名、显示名称、是否采集温度/内存。
- **可配置时钟档位** —— 任意 MHz 档位列表加 `unlimited`，一键应用到所有节点；弹层会高亮当前档位。
- **逐台失败隔离** —— 某台不可达不影响其他台；该台在悬停详情里显示错误。
- **中英词典**，Desktop 插件管理器里有原生表单。

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · 要求：- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`（Web UI / Desktop profile）。
- Node.js `>= 20`（仅本地开发需要）。
- 每台节点在 `~/.ssh/config` 里有别名，且免交互可达（`BatchMode=yes`）。
- 每台节点免密 sudo 可执行 `nvidia-smi`（`sudo -n nvidia-smi ...` 能直接跑）。
- 节点上装有 `nvidia-smi`（仅时钟功能需要）。

text:
@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · 配置：插件**不假设任何主机名**：没有配置 `hosts` 时不采样，状态条里也不显示任何东西。在 profile 的 patch 层（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`）或 Desktop 插件管理器的表单里添加节点。下面的 `node-1` / `node-2` 请换成你自己 `~/.ssh/config` 里的别名：

```yaml
- id: spark-monitor
  name: "@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor"
  config:
    hosts:

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · 配置：| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `hosts[].alias` | —（必填） | `~/.ssh/config` 中的 SSH 别名。允许字符：`A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`。不配任何主机则不采样。 |
| `hosts[].label` | 同别名 | 悬停详情里的显示名称。 |
| `hosts[].temperature` | `true` | 是否采集该节点温度。 |
| `hosts[].memory` | `true` | 是否采集该节点内存与 swap。 |
| `tiers[]` | `1710, 1950, 2190, unlimited` | 弹层提供的档位。数字为 MHz；`unlimited` 执行 `nvidia-smi -rgc`。 |
| `clock` | `true` | 是否启用 GPU 时钟档位控制。`nvidia-smi` 需要密码时设为 `false`，时钟按钮会隐藏。 |
| `intervalSeconds` | `300` | 采样间隔（30–86400 秒）。 |
| `timeoutSeconds` | `20` | 单次 SSH 命令超时（5–120 秒）。 |
@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · 配置：Desktop 插件管理器会把同样的字段渲染成表单。

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · 工作原理：- **采样**：Host 半每个周期对每台节点执行一次 SSH 命令，读取 `hwmon` 的 `temp*_input`（毫度）、`/proc/meminfo`（`MemTotal`/`MemAvailable`/`SwapTotal`/`SwapFree`）、uptime 与负载。每台快照独立保存，`ageSeconds` 由 Host 按请求计算。
- **时钟档位**：应用档位时执行 `sudo -n sh -c 'nvidia-smi -lgc 0,<MHz> && …'`（`unlimited` 用 `-rgc`），并把档位写入节点的 `/var/lib/gpu-clock-lock/tier`。之所以有记录文件，是因为驱动**没有**锁定值的查询接口，只能设/重置；下一节的可选开机 service 也写同一个文件，这样重启后状态 pill 能显示开机档位。

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · 可选：让限频在重启后保持：`nvidia-smi -lgc` 是运行时设置，重启后会失效。插件不会安装或修改任何 service——这里只是一个可选的配套示例，适合希望限频跨重启保留的人。

```ini
section: 可选：让限频在重启后保持

text:
@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · /etc/systemd/system/gpu-clock-lock.service：[Unit]
Description=Lock GPU clocks for thermal control

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/nvidia-smi -lgc 0,2190
ExecStartPost=/bin/sh -c 'mkdir -p /var/lib/gpu-clock-lock && echo 2190 > /var/lib/gpu-clock-lock/tier && chmod 644 /var/lib/gpu-clock-lock/tier'
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

把两处 `2190` 换成你自己的档位。`ExecStartPost` 只负责写档位记录文件，让状态 pill 能显示开机档位（驱动没有锁定值的查询接口）。不装这个 service 插件也能用：档位在运行时生效，重启后恢复默认，pill 显示 `—`，直到你再选一次档位。

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · 限制：- 驱动无法读回真实的锁定值；插件显示的是它最后一次应用的档位（或开机 service 的档位）。在插件之外手动执行 `nvidia-smi -lgc` 不会被感知。
- `nvidia-smi -lgc` 不跨重启保留；需要持久化请参考上方的可选开机 service。
- 时钟功能需要免密 sudo；没有的话应用会失败，并在对应节点上显示错误。
- SSH 别名必须免交互可用；请使用 `BatchMode=yes` 友好的密钥。

@zer0kara/dsh-spark-monitor README · 开发：```bash
pnpm install
node --test
```

Host 测试用假 SSH runner（`setRemoteRunner`），直接调用注册的 Fetch 路由。
